notes: P3-S0 Weapon Lab archetype params — the RESIDUAL, reviewed decisions. Everything derivable is computed by pipeline/merge/labParams.ts (its header is the tooling doc): family = the wiki category of the weapon article; classification from Module:Iteminfo/data useStyle (quoted from the Use Style IDs article), class, noMelee, channel, shoot, useAmmo, mana; swing reach/arc, magic-bolt velocity/pierce, bow-gun ammo class derived; single-projectile / no-spread / ammo-unchanged defaults only when the article screen is clean.

PARAM SEMANTICS (AMENDMENTS-008 B37, binding — see src/sim/README.md 'Cadence' and 'Param semantics'): pierce = extra dummies passed through AFTER the first hit (0 = stops at the first); projectilesPerUse = projectiles per activation (shot) within one attack — bursts come from useTime < useAnimation, never from projectilesPerUse; an ammo projectile's speed comes only from the ammo's velocityBonusTps / velocityMultiplier (bow-gun entries carry no speed); magic-bolt speed = params.projectile.velocityTps (derived from Iteminfo shootSpeed x (1 + Projectileinfo extraUpdates)), never weapon.shootSpeedTps.

An entry exists only for a weapon the article screen flagged (the build fails on an entry for a clean weapon — residuals only). decision 'archetype': a reviewer read the article and confirms the archetype fits; residual values (projectilesPerUse, spreadDegrees, inheritsAmmoProjectile, pierce, lifetimeTicks, damageMultiplierPct) must each be stated by one of the quotes (number / number word, degrees, pierce wording, seconds, '<n>% of the weapon's damage') — checked by the build. slightSpread: true = AMENDMENTS-010 B47 (a gun whose quote says slight / small spread with no angle → the labeled 10° modeling convention, listed in _prov.modeledFields). decision 'limitation': `reason` is emitted on the Lab's limitation card; the quotes document the behavior the params cannot express.

Every quote is checked verbatim against the cached revision of the cited article; the weapon's own article must be cited. `why` is pipeline-only reviewer rationale. NEVER guess: a weapon whose behavior the wiki does not pin down stays a limitation (e.g. guns whose non-slight spread angle is unstated, homing whose strength is undocumented). Modeling conventions (B44 swing geometry, B46 thrust reach, B47 slight spread) are ratified rulings, always labeled — never silent.

B48 coverage-expansion slice (AMENDMENTS-010, 2026-10-13): reuse delay is part of the sim cadence (reviewed: Clockwork Assault Rifle simulable; Sky Fracture / Betsy's Wrath stay limitations for other reasons); thrust weapons use the B46 reach convention only where the article states no range (a stated spear range is a hard limitation pending a ruling); damage over time comes from the infobox debuff rows (Frost Staff, Stylish Scissors, Brand of the Inferno reviewed); the B47 slight-spread convention covers Minishark, Megashark, S.D.M.G.

AMENDMENTS-012 B56 (2026-10-13): a range the thrust weapon's article states ('maximum range of approximately N tiles') is its reach — extracted by pipeline/merge/labParams.ts and checked verbatim on the cached revision (wiki data with normal provenance, not _prov.modeledFields); the B46 convention applies only where no range is stated. The nine plain spears (Trident, Spear, Mythril Halberd, Adamantite Glaive, Cobalt Naginata, Palladium Pike, Orichalcum Halberd, Titanium Trident, Swordfish) have reviewed entries for their screen flags only — their reach is never an overlay value.

P3-S0 remaining-archetype slice (2026-10-13): families returning (Boomerangs + Flails + Yoyos), whip (Whips), minion-sentry (Minion + Sentry summon items), explosive-aoe (Explosives + Launchers) and piercing-beam (no wiki category: held magic/ranged weapons outside every category family). Their sim interpreters ship with the Lab (P3-S6–S11): complete params are RECORDED (coverage report) and the weapon is emitted as a limitation whose reason names what the Lab does not model; the same build emits the params once the interpreter registers. Values are stated (yoyo infobox Reach, Whips list table, tooltips, verbatim 'maximum range' / fuse sentences, or a reviewed quote here that states the value) or derived (Projectileinfo minionSlots + quoted rules); a value only a new convention could supply (whip arc, average minion rates, Manhattan sentry ranges, square explosion areas) stays MISSING — proposals in the gap report, never applied. Limitation entries may record bounceCount / chainTargets / tickRateTicks (quote-checked) for the NotImplemented sim stubs.

Category-less weapons (orchestrator ruling, 2026-10-13): a weapon in no Lab family (no wiki weapon-type category, no held-beam signal) keeps the default limitation card unless a reviewed limitation entry here gives its specific reason — evidence-checked like every entry (verbatim quotes on the cached revision, its own article cited); such a weapon takes no archetype entry and no recorded extras. Reviewed: Grenade, Star Cannon, Blowpipe, Flamethrower, Snowball Cannon (consumable / ammo-driven uniques).
